name: AnimNodeKind
doc: Runtime pose operation represented by an authoring graph node.

variants.name: blend1d
variants.doc: Interpolate adjacent samples on an ordered scalar axis.

variants.name: directional2d
variants.doc: Interpolate a center and an angular ring with radial barycentric weights.

variants.name: additive
variants.doc: Add the second input's difference from the skeleton bind pose to the first.

variants.name: layer
variants.doc: Blend the second input onto the first through a per-joint mask.

variants.name: motionMatching
variants.doc: Bounded search in a normalized pose/trajectory feature database.
